# Auto-generated schematic symbols
import sys
import os

# Get project path and import kicad schematic interface
PROJECT_PATH = os.environ['PROJECT_PATH']
sys.path.append(PROJECT_PATH)
from modules.kicad_sch_interface import *

# Define center position for the resistor (R1)
center_x_1, center_y_1 = 150.0, 110.0

# Place R1 (generic resistor from Device library)
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Device",
    symbol_name="R",
    pos_x=center_x_1,
    pos_y=center_y_1,
    reference="R1",
    value="R",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# Place SW1 (generic momentary push‑button from Switch library) to the right of R1
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Switch",
    symbol_name="SW_Push",
    pos_x=center_x_1 + 30.0,   # 30 mm to the right
    pos_y=center_y_1,
    reference="SW1",
    value="SW_Push",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# Connect R1 pin 1 to SW1 pin 2
connect_pins("R1", "1", "SW1", "2")

# Connect R1 pin 2 to SW1 pin 1
connect_pins("R1", "2", "SW1", "1")

# Write out all wires
write_out_all_wires()
